input.summary: Carve express warranties out of the AS IS disclaimer and add a 12-month conformance warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy, plus workmanlike-performance, legal-compliance and no-malicious-code warranties.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Licensed Technology is currently provided wholly "AS IS" with all express and implied warranties disclaimed, so we have no conformance warranty or remedy at all. We have added a standard performance warranty (documentation conformance for twelve months, professional and workmanlike support, compliance with law, no malicious code) with a repair, replace or refund remedy, and carved it out of the disclaimer; we can discuss a 90-day software / 30-day services period as a fallback.
